prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering onboarding steps (moving sign-in after pet adoption) significantly improved performance and exceeded predictions (+16.8% measured vs +12.0% predicted).
New flow guides on finish screens showed no clear effect, and the predicted impact (+10.0%) was too high.
Adoption grid layout changes showed no clear effect, with predictions (+15.0%) being overly optimistic.
Waiting screen time estimates and error safeguards showed no clear effect, over-predicting impact (+8.0%).
Copy adjustments for path selection showed no clear effect, and predictions (+8.0%) were too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: +2.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -6.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -3.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +16.8% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Safeguard Warning: Add clear sync reassurance text to the sign-in screen confirming that your pet data will be safely linked to your account. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, creating fear of data loss during login.)
1: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Status Notification Prompt: Add a notification badge on the completion screen explaining that the pet stays active in the system tray. (why: 3 support tickets noted that the pet does not show on desktop or users cannot re-open the app after setup.)
2: [home, wait_info] Generation Status Live Progress Visualizer: Display an animated loading visualizer and step counter during the pet asset compilation phase. (why: The home step has a long median wait (201s) and mean time (2336s), creating uncertainty while assets generate.)

scores.note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails; copy adjustments historically show modest impact.
Previous finish screen guide changes showed negative measured lift (-6.6%).
Wait time safeguards previously failed to improve conversion (-3.5%) and require new visualizer components.
